tie_reference: TIE (2026). English for Secondary Schools Student's Book Form 1. Dar es Salaam: Tanzania Institute of Education.
source_note: Verified English Form One lesson plans (Arusha Catholic Seminary). 39 Term I lesson plans (1A-13C) covering Chapter One (Using ICT tools to search for information) through Chapter Six (Reading texts for comprehension), plus 24 Term II lesson plans (1A-8C) covering Chapter Seven (Comprehending oral messages) through Chapter Ten (Creating informal texts). Week 10 is mid-term assessment and break in both terms; Term II weeks 9 and 11-14 are review, mock, FTNA revision and annual-examination weeks without lesson plans. 5 periods per week (2 x 80-min double periods + 1 x 40-min single period).

lessons.title: ENGLISH FORM ONE LESSON PLAN NO. 1A (TERM I - WEEK 1, DOUBLE PERIOD - 80 min): SEARCH ENGINES AND BROWSERS

lessons.specific_competence: 1.1 Familiarising with various types of search engines and browsers
